profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer ★Quality Assurance Leader ★ D.I.Y Hobbyist thriving where creative & analytical intersect.
profile.summary:
WHO AM I?

I am Tracy Smith, a Sr. Software Engineer and Quality Assurance professional that enjoys tackling D.I.Y. projects in my spare time.  That famous right brain or left brain theory maybe true for some, however,  I enjoy the benefits of both. 
My passion for  creating, enhancing and fixing things fuels me professionally and personally. It is only surpassed by the sense of accomplishment  I feel when projects are complete.

WHAT I DO AND HOW?

I consistently leverage my creative ability and technical acumen to develop software that exceeds the expectations of end users and is technically sound.  I take pride in the awards I have received for delivering excellent results and leading Quality Assurance teams during challenging times and projects.  

WHAT HAVE I BEEN UP TO?

Over the past 15 years, my roles have increased in responsibility, affording me opportunities to remain abreast of global IT/QA trends and software. 

TECHNOLOGY/SYSTEMS USED:

Java, JavaScript, AngularJS, Agile, GitHub,  Protractor, Selenium, JIRA, Window 7/8,  HP Application LifeCycle Management (ALM), Unix, Pivioal Tracker, CI/CD with Concourse, DB Visualizer.

INDUSTRIES SERVED:

Retail/Home Improvement, Telecommunications and  Medical/Healthcare.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Leverages Protractor, Selenium, AngularJS, Javascript, CI/CD Pipeline with Concourse, and GitHub to design and develop software design, to support Home Depot stores.

positions.title: Lead Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Spearheaded all testing phases from Test Planning, Test Prep, Test Execution, along with Defect 
Validation/Verification using HP ALM (Quality Center) for Agile/XP/Waterfall projects.

	Led on average 7 on and offshore QA Testers on various projects.
	Recognized as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Front End Point of Sale (POS) QA team.
    Promoted to Sr. Software Engineer

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst/Test Lead
positions.description:
Led all testing phases from Test Planning, Test Prep, Test Execution, and defect validation/verification using HP/Mercury Quality Center and Borland StarTeam

  Managed Testcase Execution, Defect Verification and Validations while overseeing the tasks of 7 CS team members

positions.title: Verification Test Engineer
positions.description: Led software upgrades on Java-based Linux Servers, Windows Based Client, Ethernet and TL-driven system.

positions.title: Sr.  Product Test Engineer
positions.description: Served as member of the support team for  In-Service Introduction of Hardware, software, and Network Solutions. Responsibilities included switching  network for Sprint’s Local, Long-Distance, and International customers.

honors.title: Received 4 Associate Homer Awards at Home Depot
honors.description:
Received "Homer Associate Awards" from Home Depot  Staff. These awards are given to associates that go over and beyond.

 Day Build Project-Habitat                                                                              1/2016
IT Habitat Volunteer                                                                                           6/2015
 Recognized for volunteer on Phase  of WSR Application Project    2.2014
 Deliver of POS Cashier Project                                                                       2/2014
